Module 862 is a hanging *rebuild* of a dependency (`Book1Variants.Prop46`'s chain) — outside my Prop47 files, blocking all Main builds. At session start this dependency was cached; my extensive building invalidated it, and its euclid_finish now hangs on rebuild. Let me give it an unlimited-time build to see if it eventually completes (caching it) or is genuinely infinite.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; echo "===== Book1Variants.Prop46 unlimited ====="; /usr/bin/time -v timeout 2800 lake build Book1Variants.Prop46 > /tmp/p46b.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -aE "Building|Built Book1Variants.Prop46|✖|error|Elapsed" /tmp/p46b.log | grep -av "trace:" | tail -8; echo "=== last modules ==="; grep -aoE "\[8[0-9][0-9]/873\] [A-Za-z]+ [A-Za-z0-9._]+" /tmp/p46b.log | tail -4; echo ALLDONE
<<<END>>>
